name: p9-mv-aim
description: P9 cell P9-MV (lane COV-MV, task-COV-MV-report.md; Ruling COV-7, funded, 0 trials until run; registration scripts/specs/p9/rules/mv-aim-v1.json, the rule fixed blind before any read): NAV target rule mv-aim-v1 on the pinned atx-cov-v1 container store (Ruling W3-10: build-equity/p9-m2i-dcov-covv1, manifest SHA-256 ea58691fc40745049a2eaf51e48136cd84bfc3cd56f397eb4630af8ec3a0f0f3; PRE-29). Hypothesis (Menchero, Wang and Orr 2011, Eigen-Adjusted Covariance Matrices, MSCI Research Insight, US sample 1993-07-01 to 2010-07-30; Menchero, Wang and Orr 2012, FAJ 68(3); cov-design section 5.2): a max-Sharpe tilt V^-1 alpha on an eigen-adjusted factor model loads the small eigen-directions the adjustment corrects, so at equal gross alpha it lowers ex-ante and realised volatility. Rule (atx-impl strategy_mv_aim.cpp over engine book/mv_target.cpp): at every rebalance decision d whose shared desired target proceeds, the priced members (a member with a finite desired weight and a risk row at d: industry slot 0..49 and a finite specific variance D_i > 0) take g x w, w = P V_d^-1 P alpha / sum |P V_d^-1 P alpha|, alpha_i = sqrt(D_i) desired_i, P the dollar-neutral projection on the priced names, V_d = X F X' + D of store row d (RiskStore::read(d), Ruling COV-4), solved without inverting F (Ruling COV-13 (c)), g = the desired target's gross over the priced names (Ruling W3-17); unpriced members and nonmembers keep their weights; fewer than two priced names, no forecast or a flat tilt: unchanged and counted. No constant (no IC, horizon, ridge, cap, clip or floor). Construction (aim-partial-v5) and the parent's leverage follow unchanged. The change comes only from the atx.research-wave/v2 manifest's rules block [{name: mv-aim-v1, params: {risk_model: build-equity/p9-m2i-dcov-covv1, risk_model_sha256: ea58691fc40745049a2eaf51e48136cd84bfc3cd56f397eb4630af8ec3a0f0f3}}] (Rulings ALCOMB-1, PRE-9: the NAV flags --target-rule mv-aim-v1 --risk-model --risk-model-sha256 are derived from the NAV exe's target row by wave_kinds.nav_flags, never from this template); the parent's NAV must run --rule aim-partial-v5 without --two-speed, --adv-hold-q, --hold-band or --construction-grid and without an spo rule or aim-partial-v6 (the NAV exe refuses them with the rule). NAV-only cell: the NAV and monitor outputs are renamed; u, fit, card and w are the parent's. Gross matching (PM6-6) binds the cell through C2's engine calibration (gross_match pm6-6-engine): the rule keeps the desired target's gross, the calibration matches the book's realised gross to the parent's. Acceptance pm7-34. Printed, deciding nothing: the summary block mv_aim (priced and unpriced name counts, the specific-vol ratio of Ruling PRE-24a, the eigen 00-02 share of Ruling COV-13 (c) for the MV and the desired target, the pass-through counts, the special-tier negative count under --locate-in-aim), turnover per unit gross, cost per traded dollar vs the parent, the capacity curve and net Sharpe at 4x NAV. Identity before the cell: the parent's NAV argv re-run on the new build is byte-identical (no target rule; summary.json /producer substituted).
requires: lane COV-MV merged in root and reviewed APPROVE before the P9 cells start (Ruling COV-7; else P9-MV lapses at 0, PRE-14)
